limitations: Two fine-tuning seeds from one selected actor and reused validation; no independent confirmation.
Final missing health can include damage present at continuation start. This changes the objective, not policy-invariant potential shaping.
Even though each loss bonus is smaller than a win reward, the expected-utility tradeoff can change; report wins and paired HP separately.
Terminal enemy health is owner-attested public HUD, not reconstructible from the canonical terminal footer alone.
operation_notes: Initial inspector export requested16workers and stopped at the8-worker limit before creating an export. Corrected to8, verified all previously created hardlinks, then successfully exported294traces. No production or frozen protocol sources changed.

calibration.source: One shared parent-policy sample. Complete episodes only for MC targets; no PPO update. TRAIN source-group 80/20 fit/monitor partition; no early stopping or selection.
calibration.target: Base Monte Carlo return plus weight times final missing enemy health on defeat; gamma=1. Same examples and minibatch-index stream with replacement per paired seed.

evaluation.primary: Final50k unshaped validation greedy wins, matched per-seed comparison to control. Boss HP on common losses and player HP on common wins, sampled wins and mean boss HP across all outcomes are secondary.
evaluation.reward: All evaluation uses common unshaped +1win+.1winningHPfraction; training returns under different reward weights are not performance scores.
evaluation.selection: Fixed endpoint; diagnostic0/25k only, no early stopping, no test restoration.
evaluation.uncertainty: Two seeds from one previously selected actor and reused42-case validation; no fresh-test confirmation.

protocol.initialization: Same selected250k rich-combat actor/vocabulary. Identical freshly seeded value heads per paired seed, calibrated per reward on shared TRAIN data. All actor parameters and logits held unchanged; fresh PPO optimizer and RNG, disjoint continuation cursors.
protocol.reward: Only confirmed defeat pays weight*(1-sum(final enemy HP)/sum(final max HP)). Control0, quarter.25, half.5. Wins retain1+.1winningHPfraction. No ordinary-action or cutoff bonus. Known public health required even at zero weight. This changes utility, not potential-based shaping. Continuations may begin with prior damage.

question: Does terminal partial credit for final missing enemy health improve Vantom combat?

results.hp_definition: Winning HP uses canonical completed CombatSummary after post-combat hooks, matching the reward. Raw evaluation player_hp is before those hooks and is not used for the headline metric. Boss HP comes from the retained stable enemy slot.
results.interpretation: Exploratory two-seed terminal-reward pilot from one inherited actor after matched TRAIN-only value calibration. Final 50k is primary; 0/25k are diagnostics. The parent was previously selected on this reused validation and every arm inherits it. No independent test confirmation. Conditional HP means can change when win/loss populations change; common-outcome deltas are paired.

timing.note: Measured phases are nested in pilot time. Implementation and review elapsed times were not separately measured.

training_audit.semantics: All scalar rewards recomputed from versioned components and terminal owner-attested enemy HUD. Selected sidecars rejoined to full public trajectories. No claim that a terminal RunOutcome alone proves the HP measurement.
